name: AI-Powered Financial SaaS
demand: Exact search volume and demand for this specific WhatsApp tracker: unverified. Reach proxies: Brazil had 183 million internet users in early 2025; in 2025, 90.2% of Brazilian internet users used messaging apps and 74.2% accessed banks or other financial institutions online. Cetic.br found 91% of surveyed Brazilian internet users aged 16+ accessed WhatsApp daily in 2025. Personal-finance need is plausible: a June 2025 survey found 75% paid much or some attention to tracking personal finances. Comparable app usage is material: Sensor Tower estimates Mobills had 495k–515k weekly active users in Brazil during Q2 2025. These are reach and category proxies, not the addressable market or proof of willingness to pay for this product. Sources: https://www.inca.gov.br/sites/ufu.sti.inca.local/files/media/document/ata_comite_de_governanca_06.10.2025.pdf ; https://agenciadenoticias.ibge.gov.br/agencia-noticias/2012-agencia-de-noticias/noticias/47408-proporcao-de-usuarios-da-internet-no-pais-ultrapassou-90-da-populacao-de-10-anos-ou-mais-em-2025 ; https://www.cetic.br/media/docs/publicacoes/2/en-us/20260408150920/ict_panel_information_integrity_2025_book_en.pdf ; https://portal.febraban.org.br/noticia/4324/pt-br/www.febraban.org.br/paginas/ ; https://sensortower.com/blog/2025-q2-unified-top-5-personal%20finance%20budgeting%20and%20planning-revenue-br-63e363f0e1714cfff1979caa
prices: The listing asks US$9.90/month or US$99.90/year. Current comparable offers found: Sobra R$5.90/month; FinWapp free or R$9.90/month; Controla Fácil R$9.90/month; FinanBot R$9.90/month basic or R$19.90/month Plus; Poupa.ai free with the user's own AI subscription or R$19.83/month billed annually. These are advertised prices, not verified transactions. Sources: https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/ai-powered-financial-saas ; https://sobraapp.com/ ; https://www.finwapp.com.br/ ; https://controlafacilai.com.br/ ; https://finanbot.com.br/ ; https://poupa.ai/

revenue_proof.claim: Seller claims US$300 TTM revenue, US$100 MRR, US$300 ARR and 15 customers, and says paying subscribers were verified. The page publishes no payment ledger or processor evidence; US$100 MRR does not reconcile with the displayed US$300 ARR. Treat lead revenue as unverified.
revenue_proof.claim_event_date: 2026-05-19 listing snapshot; underlying transaction dates and TTM window are unstated

revenue_proof.claim: Sensor Tower estimated Mobills' weekly revenue peaked around US$33k in early May 2025, with weekly active users rising from 495k to 515k during Q2 2025. Third-party estimate for a larger comparable app, not audited company accounts.

Sensor Tower estimated Organizze weekly revenue at US$12.8k in the last week of June 2025 and weekly active users declining from 215k to 208k during Q2 2025. Third-party estimate for a comparable app, not audited company accounts.

copy_speed: Fast feature copying is visible. BTG announced Minhas Finanças on 2026-05-12, combining AI, Open Finance and WhatsApp within its banking app. GranaZen announced an Open Finance addition on 2026-05-21 to its existing WhatsApp product. Guaiaca's changelog dates WhatsApp finance queries to 2026-10-07. Febraban launched a free WhatsApp financial-education AI assistant on 2026-10-21; it advises but is not a transaction tracker. Confi was reported launched in Peru in 2026-04. These include adjacent products and feature additions; a verified launch date for each direct Brazilian tracker rival was not found. Sources: https://www.moneyreport.com.br/negocios/btg-lanca-ferramenta-de-gestao-financeira-que-integra-ia-open-finance-e-assistencia-via-whatsapp/ ; https://blog.granazen.com/blog/ia-whatsapp-open-finance-contas-bancarias-investimentos/ ; https://guaiaca.com.br/changelog ; https://portal.febraban.org.br/noticia/4509/pt-br/ ; https://www.attentionterminal.com/article/whatsapp-finance-bots-latam
platform_risk: High WhatsApp dependence: the listing says it uses Meta Cloud API. Meta requires opt-in before contacting users, approved templates to initiate conversations outside the 24-hour service window, and charges for messages; it may restrict or remove access for policy violations or negative feedback. The policy also bars asking for or sharing full payment-card or financial-account numbers. Processing Brazilian customers' personal data falls under LGPD when offering services to people in Brazil, including when the operator is abroad. Sources: https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/ai-powered-financial-saas ; https://whatsappbusiness.com/policy/ ; https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2015-2018/2018/lei/l13709compilado.htm
defensible_asset: No established moat is evidenced. The seller claims source code, WhatsApp workflows, a dashboard and a customer database, but public evidence does not establish ownership transfer, data-use rights or durable switching costs. The product is currently Brazilian Portuguese only; no UK-specific financial data or rules engine is listed. Transaction history and categorization corrections could become useful assets if accumulated with appropriate permissions, but that is a future possibility, not a demonstrated asset. Source: https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/ai-powered-financial-saas
build_effort: Moderate technical diligence and localization effort, not a greenfield build if the seller's claims are accurate: the listing describes a React/TypeScript PWA, Supabase/Postgres, Stripe, Gemini/GPT and Meta Cloud API, and calls it production-ready. Exact audit, migration and ongoing hours are unverified. The seller says the founder currently handles product, software architecture/operations, paid marketing and customer support, so agent-run operations are not demonstrated. Source: https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/ai-powered-financial-saas
channel: Use a product brand, Brazilian-Portuguese SEO pages and exact-intent paid search with explicit opt-in; this avoids Ricardo's face and personal brand and does not depend on local-business sales. Do not use cold email, SMS, WhatsApp or social DMs to individuals or sole traders: ICO guidance treats stored social DMs as electronic mail and requires consent or a qualifying soft opt-in for individual subscribers, including sole traders. Meta separately requires WhatsApp opt-in. Sources: https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/business-to-business-marketing/ ; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/direct-marketing-guidance/plan-direct-marketing/ ; https://whatsappbusiness.com/policy/
owner_hours_per_week: Unverified. The listing gives the founder's responsibilities but no weekly hours; it does not substantiate Ricardo's <=5 hours/week constraint. Source: https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/ai-powered-financial-saas
desk_test: In one day, with no product build: first check the listing, which is currently marked Already Sold; that blocks this acquisition unless the current owner can prove title and availability. For category demand, create a clearly labelled Brazilian-Portuguese landing page under a product brand at the listing's posted price, run a tightly capped exact-intent Google Search test, and collect explicit opt-ins plus a refundable paid reservation. No cold messages. Search volume, CPC, and a viable conversion threshold are unverified; set the threshold against verified acquisition and retention economics, which the listing does not provide. Sources: https://www.microns.io/startup-listings/ai-powered-financial-saas ; https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/direct-marketing-and-privacy-and-electronic-communications/business-to-business-marketing/ ; https://whatsappbusiness.com/policy/
red_flags: The listing is marked Already Sold today; the sale date and current ownership are unstated. Revenue figures conflict and are not publicly substantiated; customer, beta-user and conversion counts are seller claims. CAC is listed as unavailable. The seller's posted price competes with multiple lower-priced BRL plans and free tiers. Product is Brazilian Portuguese only and includes small businesses in its stated target audience, which should be excluded under Ricardo's constraints. Owner hours and automation share are unverified; the seller describes founder-led marketing and support. WhatsApp policy, message pricing and access restrictions are material platform risks.
